code_name: Ball drop that lands on a level and snaps the slider
summary: A dark "Reasoning effort" panel with a plinko board of grey pegs; pressing Again drops a glowing ball through the pegs into one of six bins (Auto to Ultra), and the purple slider below slides to the level it landed on.

credit.author: zanwei
credit.note: Recreated by eye from the public preview; this demo is original code.
